planned_by: Claude (Critic): owner requests — rounds UI, fun challenges, public start
goal:
T85 — owner requests 2026-10-30: per-round missions from the input, fun challenges to try, and anyone may start runs
within the server's daily limit (T84 API: POST /v1/arena/prompt {"rounds": [...]}, GET /v1/arena/limits). This REPLACES
the operator-only start (NEXT_PUBLIC_EVO_OPERATOR_CONTROLS) for the prompt bar and the Arena page; keep the spend
confirmation (window.confirm with the cost warning). Web only; keep Codex's canvas design language and 375px fit.
1. apps/web/lib/challenges.ts: export CHALLENGES (>= 5) = {id, title: {en, ko}, rounds: {en: string[], ko: string[]}}
   — fun multi-round builds (2..5 rounds each, each mission 10..300 chars, same count in both languages), e.g. a bakery
   site that gains a menu, then prices, then opening hours; a tip calculator that gains splitting and rounding; a
   password meter; a to-do list; a unit converter. Missions must be buildable as one app.py render(state=None) page.
   export planFits(remaining: number | null, rounds: number): boolean — null never blocks; else rounds <= remaining.
2. lib/api.ts: postPromptArena(prompt, feedback, single_apply, rounds?: string[]) sends "rounds" when non-empty;
   export function getArenaLimits() -> GET /v1/arena/limits.
3. components/PromptBar.tsx: round fields R1..R5 ("Add round" up to 5 total, remove for R2+), a Challenges menu that
   fills the fields in the current locale, "today N of M runs left" from getArenaLimits (refresh after a start), start
   disabled with plan.limit-reached text when !planFits(remaining, rounds); follow-up mode (existing) still sends one
   follow-up. Remove NEXT_PUBLIC_EVO_OPERATOR_CONTROLS from PromptBar and from the Arena page start
   (app/[locale]/arena/page.tsx: gate its start on getArenaLimits too).
4. en + ko messages under "plan": add-round, remove-round, round-label, remaining-today, limit-reached, challenges.
5. Update YOUR earlier tests that assert the operator flag (services/api/tests/test_muse_t65.py, test_muse_t67.py,
   test_muse_t63.py if affected) to the new rule (getArenaLimits + confirm), without weakening what else they check.
Keep apps/web/scripts/check-studio-render.mjs and tsc green. Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t85.py.
